description: This Java class 'HealthService' provides application and database health check functionalities within a Spring Boot project. It determines the overall service health and checks database connectivity/status using a DataSource.

classes.name: HealthService
classes.description: A service component providing health checks for the application and its database.

methods.name: HealthService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HealthService with an optional DataSource.

methods.name: checkServiceHealth
methods.description: Performs a minimal service health check, currently always reports UP.

methods.name: checkDatabaseHealth
methods.description: Checks database connectivity and validity of the connection, returns DOWN if database is not configured or unreachable.
